items.summary: CFO recommendation: maintain financial containment. Do not admit new work, spend, prototypes, or monetization claims while delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots and attribution is insufficient. Amazon data covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. Site-attributed commission is $0; the $4.92 cannot be assigned to a site, so revenue, contribution margin, ROI, payback, and causal lift are unsupported. Complete or close the existing saveusfarms.com repair-or-close case by 2026-10-01T09:00Z, then release one slot for the already-queued allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement. Measure registered affiliate clicks only; baseline is 61 clicks on 2026-09-21.

Finance gate for the queued allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement: execute only after one delivery slot is released. Preserve the registered affiliate destination, tracking ID, and disclosure. Measure registered affiliate clicks for 14 days or 100 relevant impressions. Do not claim orders, commission, margin, ROI, or causal lift unless named provider revenue and comparable pre/post evidence exist.

September AI usage is $997.51762695 for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-30 across 5,522 calls, including 234 errors and 5 transient errors. Cost per call is approximately $0.181, but cost-to-learn, cost per conversion, and AI contribution margin are not calculable because comparable attributed revenue, experiment exposure, labor/infrastructure costs, and outcome linkage are absent. The brief also provides no monthly spend limit, fixed-cost baseline, marketing budget, or revenue target. Treat AI spend as known exposure, not proof of return; authorize no incremental spend this cycle.
